name: Alterac Valley Graveyards
label: Quest
description: Alterac Valley Graveyards: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The graveyards in Alterac Valley are prized territories. Both the Horde and the Alliance fight savagely for these sacred grounds. Are you, friend, ready to join that fight?
I want you to assault an enemy graveyard. Find a graveyard with a Horde banner in its midst, and pull it from the ground! Do that, and your task will be complete....
But if you can also hold the graveyard for a few minutes, then our troops will soon come to relieve you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, you have not yet assaulted a graveyard. Return to me when this task is complete!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done! Graveyards are vital to our control of Alterac Valley. When you capture one, you help ensure the Alliance's sovereignty here.
Go now, friend. Reenter the battle, and if you see a graveyard under the Horde's control... You know what to do!
